notes: Original research paper (J. Mater. Chem. 'PAPER'). H2 uptake on the carbide-derived carbon monolith HPCDCM measured volumetrically at -196 C: Quantachrome Autosorb 1C up to 1 bar (24 mg g-1 at 1 bar, Fig. 8a) and BELSORP-HP up to 100 bar (maximum Gibbs excess 44 mg H2 g-1 at 36 bar, Fig. 8b). HPCDCM is majority carbon (TG: residual mass below 1 wt% at 750 C after carbon combustion; EDX chlorine 4.3 wt%). BET area 2933 m2 g-1 (p/p0 0.05-0.2, N2 at -196 C). record.json is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the PDF; no statement that the H2 data were published before. Comparison values for OM-CDC and microporous CDC powders are quoted from refs 18, 28 and 44 and were not used for any criterion. Text layer drops minus signs; quotes checked against page images.
